title: HoloUI Menu Config
description: Defines a HoloUI menu and all its components.

offset.description: Offset from the player's feet location (Player#getLocation), which acts as the menu centre. Component rotation pivots on the eye; the X component is negated on load. Not scaled by uiScale.

lockPosition.description: Defines whether the player is able to move while a menu is open, or will be frozen in place.

followPlayer.description: Defines whether the menu follows the player, or will be frozen in place.

maxDistance.description: Defines the maximum distance between the player and menu before it closes.

closeOnDeath.description: Defines whether the menu closes when the player dies. Defaults to false.

closeOnTeleport.description: Defines whether the menu closes when the player teleports. Defaults to false. A teleport that leaves the menu's world or its range closes the menu regardless.

components.description: A list of menu components present in this menu.

component.title: HoloUI Component Object
component.description: Defines the basic properties of a component.

id.description: A unique identifier for this menu option.

offset.description: The offset relative to the menu's center point.

data.description: The type and associated data of the object.

componentData.title: Component Data Object
componentData.description: Defines the type and data of a component.

action.title: Component Action Data Object
action.description: Describes the actual effects of a interact-able component.

trigger.description: Optional click binding. Omitted or null matches every accepted main-hand click.

iconDisplayStyle.title: Icon Display Style
iconDisplayStyle.description: Optional display-entity metadata shared by text, image, item, block, and custom-item icons. Packet entity icons do not accept this object.

icon.title: Component Icon Data Object
icon.description: Defines the visual parts of a component.

style.description: Optional display styling. Omitted uses fixed, fully visible, unlit-override defaults at uniform scale 1.

hitbox.title: Button Hitbox
hitbox.description: Optional click-plane dimensions, anchor and displacement in blocks before uiScale is applied.

width.description: Click-plane width in blocks at uiScale 1.

height.description: Click-plane height in blocks at uiScale 1.

offset.description: Displacement from the selected anchor in right, up, forward blocks at uiScale 1.

anchor.description: Whether offset is relative to the button or the menu centre. Menu anchoring detaches button and plane movement.

buttonComponent.title: Button Component Data Object
buttonComponent.description: Defines the data for a button component.

highlightModifier.description: Defines by how much a highlighted button moves towards the player.

actions.description: Defines what happens upon a interaction.

icon.description: Defines the visual part of the component.

hitbox.description: Optional dimensions and displacement for the click plane. Omitted dimensions remain automatic; omitted offset remains icon-aligned.

decoComponent.title: Decoration Component Data Object
decoComponent.description: Defines the data for a decorative component.

icon.description: Defines the visual parts of a component.

toggleComponent.title: Toggle Component Data Object
toggleComponent.description: Defines the data for a toggle component.

highlightModifier.description: Defines by how much a highlighted button moves towards the player.

condition.description: Defines what placeholder value is used to determine the toggles initial state.

expectedValue.description: Defines what the condition is checked against to determine the toggles initial state.

trueActions.description: Defines what happens upon a interaction that enters the true state, so upon a interaction while the toggle is false.

falseActions.description: Defines what happens upon a interaction that enters the false state, so upon a interaction while the toggle is true.

trueIcon.description: Defines the visual part of the component while the toggle is in the true state.

falseIcon.description: Defines the visual part of the component while the toggle is in the false state.

commandAction.title: Command Action Data Object
commandAction.description: Defines the data for a command action.

command.description: Defines the command run by this action.

source.description: Defines the source of this command. Defaults to "player", so the command runs as the clicking player unless "server" is written explicitly.

soundAction.title: Sound Action Data Object
soundAction.description: Defines the data for a sound action.

sound.description: Defines the sound played by this action. An unknown sound key is logged when the component resolves its actions and the action is dropped.

source.description: Defines the audio channel of this sound. Defaults to "master".

volume.description: Defines the volume modifier for this sound. Defaults to 1.0.

pitch.description: Defines the pitch modifier for this sound. Defaults to 1.0.

messageAction.title: Player Message Action Data Object
messageAction.description: Sends a MiniMessage-formatted message to the clicking player.

message.description: MiniMessage text sent to the player. %player% and PlaceholderAPI placeholders are resolved for the clicking player before parsing.

teleportAction.title: Player Teleport Action Data Object
teleportAction.description: Teleports the clicking player asynchronously to an already-loaded namespaced world.

world.description: Explicit lowercase namespace:key of an already-loaded Bukkit world.

connectAction.title: Proxy Server Connect Action Data Object
connectAction.description: Requests a BungeeCord-compatible proxy connection for the clicking player.

server.description: Configured proxy server name. Only letters, numbers, dot, underscore, and hyphen are accepted.

navigationAction.title: Navigation Action Data Object
navigationAction.description: Changes the current viewer's native menu page stack. Navigation is terminal for actions matching the current click trigger.

target.description: Exact menu id opened by push or replace navigation.

textIcon.title: Text Icon Data Object
textIcon.description: Defines the data for a text icon.

text.description: Defines the text displayed by this icon. Supports ampersand color codes, placeholders, and line breaks.

refreshTicks.description: Ticks between live PlaceholderAPI updates. Omitted defaults to 10; 0 disables updates after the initial render.

textImageIcon.title: Text Image Icon Data Object
textImageIcon.description: Defines the data for a text-image icon.

path.description: Defines the path to the image displayed, relative to the "images" directory.

animatedTextImageIcon.title: Animated Text Image Icon Data Object
animatedTextImageIcon.description: Defines the data for an animated text-image icon.

source.description: Defines the paths to the animation frames, relative to the "images" directory. A single path is accepted in place of the array.

speed.description: Defines the amount of ticks between frame advances. Values of 1 or less advance every tick.

itemIcon.title: Item Icon Data Object
itemIcon.description: Defines the data for an item icon.

item.description: Defines the type of item displayed.

count.description: Defines the count of the item stack constructed from the material.

customModelValue.description: Defines the custom model data property for use with resource packs.

customItemIcon.title: Custom Item Icon Data Object
customItemIcon.description: Defines the data for a custom-item icon resolved through an installed item-provider plugin.

provider.description: Defines the item provider that resolves the item. Omitted, blank or "auto" tries every active provider in activation order.

item.description: Defines the provider-specific item id, passed through verbatim.

count.description: Defines the count of the resolved item stack. Zero and negative values become 1.

blockIcon.title: Block Icon Data Object
blockIcon.description: Defines a packet-only block display using the material's default block state. It renders and receives an automatic click plane at 0.75 blocks square before UI and display-style scaling.

block.description: Lowercase Bukkit material id. An omitted namespace defaults to minecraft. The resolved material must be a block.

entityIcon.title: Entity Icon Data Object
entityIcon.description: Defines a packet-only spawnable living entity. The component anchor is the entity's feet; width and height define its automatic click plane and editor footprint in blocks at uiScale 1.

entity.description: Lowercase Bukkit entity registry id. An omitted namespace defaults to minecraft; only spawnable living entity types are accepted.

width.description: Automatic click-plane width in blocks at uiScale 1. Omitted defaults to 1.

height.description: Automatic click-plane height in blocks at uiScale 1. Omitted defaults to 1 and the plane is centered half this height above the component anchor.
